decisions.Evidence: Saved Yamato archive entry 7 confirms the full sentences 中水利用を行うことになっている / 注水利用を行うことになっている. The shared 利用 is usage context; the independent contrast is 中水 / 注水. The researcher confirmed the word pair and 中水 reading. IPADIC exact 注水 entry is チュウスイ. The published MLIT glossary gives 中水[チュウスイ]. Original audio is unverified.
decisions.Reason: Adopt the researcher-confirmed word contrast 中水 / 注水 while retaining 利用 in both original contexts. Both readings are チュウスイ; this is a lexical/meaning contrast under the researcher's correction criteria. Original audio is unverified.

decisions.Evidence: Original CSV row 39mag_benesse_16332_002 and its Note explicitly report 誤って as misheard for 謝って in the childhood example. Contextual complete-form readings are アヤマッテ on both sides. The cited article was not fetched and original audio was not verified; these uncertainties remain explicit.
decisions.Reason: Use the complete lexical forms 誤って / 謝って. Preserve the contextual meaning distinction 過失で / 謝罪して. Equal readings do not erase the orthographic/lexical ambiguity; source article and original audio remain unverified.

decisions.Evidence: Original CSV Src/Tgt and Note report 乗りますか？ misheard as 降りますか？. IPADIC distinguishes 降りるの降り=オリ from 降るの降り=フリ; the vehicle context selects オリ. The complete forms read ノリマス / オリマス. The cited page does not verify original audio.
decisions.Reason: Compare the complete inflected words 乗ります / 降ります rather than stems 乗り / 降り. The shared ending ます belongs to both forms and remains inside the word boundary.

decisions.Evidence: Original CSV Note explicitly reports 袋あります misheard as 袋いります, with the context of a mistaken offer of a shopping bag. The complete predicates are あります / いります, read アリマス / イリマス. The original audio was not verified.
decisions.Reason: Compare the complete predicate words あります / いります; the ます ending is part of each word and cannot be omitted as shared context.

decisions.Evidence: Original CSV Note states that 洗いたい was misheard as 会いたい. The complete contextual forms read アライタイ / アイタイ. decisions.Reason: Compare the full inflected words 洗いたい / 会いたい, retaining たい within the boundary. The Note supports the intended forms; this correction does not claim original-audio verification.

decisions.Evidence: Saved Yamato HTML archive entry 6 gives the complete pair 伺えない / 疑えない. The current [0,2) spans omit ない from the possible negative forms and can be mistaken for other readings such as an imperative. Existing qualifiers are empty; original audio is unverified.
decisions.Reason: Compare the complete words 伺えない / 疑えない rather than their stems. Preserve the common inflection ない within both word boundaries.

decisions.Evidence: Saved Yamato archive entry 9 gives the complete pair 見込めないか / 認めないか. The selected contrast is 見込めない / 認めない; shared か remains in the original question context. Both earlier spans selected only stems and omitted ない. Original audio is unverified.
decisions.Reason: Compare the complete lexical forms 見込めない / 認めない, including the shared ない ending.
